rationale_overall: Standing at 2022-12-31 close, the watchlist already sits at its 12-ticker cap with at least one holding mapped to every wave named in the profile: AI mega-caps (AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA, the AI bucket's 4-ticker diversity ceiling already reached), general markets (SPY), rockets/spacecraft (RKLB), robotics (BOTZ), quantum (IONQ), nuclear (SMR), geopolitical/defense (ITA), commodities/tanker geopolitics (FRO), and demographics (WELL). Pass-1 discovery searches on every named wave surfaced no un-held ticker with a concrete Oct-Dec 2022 commercial or structural catalyst strong enough to displace a current holding. Pass-2 due diligence found supportive, dated evidence for every current holding instead of a breach: ChatGPT's Nov 30 2022 launch is real-time confirmation the AI wave is still in its buildup/early-surge innings (not yet a crest to trim); Rocket Lab posted record Q3 revenue (+1,093% YoY) on Nov 9; IonQ called Q3 2022 'an important inflection point'; Welltower's Q3 print showed record RevPOR growth as senior-housing occupancy recovers; Frontline and the broader tanker complex are being lifted by the EU/G7 $60 Russian-oil price cap (effective Dec 5) forcing longer reroutes; European rearmament continued through Q4, supporting ITA; NuScale remains the only NRC-certified SMR design. Apple's Zhengzhou Foxconn COVID disruption (Oct-Nov 2022) is noted as a transitory headwind, not a thesis breach. Net effect: no change to the watchlist's thematic shape this quarter; every named wave keeps its incumbent exposure and the cap-constrained slate holds.
